# Elite Estimating Solutions

> Elite Estimating Solutions is an outsourced construction estimating and quantity takeoff company based in Kalispell, Montana. It prepares bid ready cost estimates for general contractors, subcontractors and builders across the United States and Canada, for every trade, usually in 24 to 48 hours.

Elite Estimating Solutions works as an on demand estimating department for contractors. It adds takeoff and pricing capacity for busy bid weeks without the cost of a full time hire. Labor and material costs are priced for the ZIP code of each project. Fees are quoted per project, with no subscription or retainer, and clients keep the final say over every number they submit.

## Pages

- [Home](https://eliteestimatingsolutions.com/): What the company does, why contractors use it, sample takeoff sheets and cost estimates, client feedback, frequently asked questions, the first project offer, and the estimator team with direct emails.
- [The Estimating Guide](https://eliteestimatingsolutions.com/estimating-guide.html): Ten common ways construction estimates go wrong, such as underbidding, missed line items and rushed bids, with the fix for each.
- [Contact](https://eliteestimatingsolutions.com/contact.html): General inquiries, project quote requests and contact details.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Elite Estimating Solutions. Short name: Elite Estimating.
- Website: https://eliteestimatingsolutions.com
- Office: 1001 S Main St Ste 600, Kalispell, MT 59901, United States.
- Email: info@eliteestimatingsolutions.com
- Services: construction cost estimating and quantity takeoffs for general construction, concrete, masonry, roofing, drywall, paint, flooring, plumbing, HVAC, mechanical, electrical, MEP and sitework.
- Clients: general contractors, subcontractors, builders, developers and project managers.
- Coverage: United States and Canada.
- Turnaround: usually 24 to 48 hours from receipt of plans.
- Pricing: quoted per project; local ZIP code pricing for labor and materials; 50% off the first project for new clients.
- Support: 24/7 customer support through the support form in the footer of every page.
- Chief Estimator: David Wilson.

## Not to be confused with

Elite Estimating Solutions is an independent company. It is not connected to Elite Estimation Services or any other business with a similar name.
